entities.name: Bacterial uS2 ribosomal protein
observations: The 287-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to curated Mycobacterium bovis and Mycobacterium tuberculosis uS2 proteins.
uS2 is a structural constituent of the bacterial 30S small ribosomal subunit.
The protein is associated with the cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and translation.
Pfam Ribosomal_S2 domain PF00318.26 spans residues 9–224.
The C-terminal region around residues 254–287 is annotated as disordered, with low-complexity composition around residues 254–277.
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; this is consistent with a ribosomal structural protein rather than an enzyme.
Sequence-derived properties: 287 aa, approximately 31.1 kDa, theoretical pI 6.03, predicted charge at pH 7 about -3.0.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: uS2 participates in translation as a component of the cytosolic 30S ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: Cytosolic 30S ribosomal subunit
observations: The protein is a component of the bacterial cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and is part of the 30S particle.
